Title: Bug list can be filtered by status
Steps:
1. Open the Bugs page
2. Choose "resolved" in the status filter
Expected result: Only bugs with status resolved are listed
Preconditions: At least one bug is resolved

Title: New test suite appears in the list after saving
Steps: Open Test suites | Click "+ New test suite" | Fill in name and feature | Click Save
Expected result: The new suite is shown at the top of the list

Title: Dashboard shows the number of open bugs
Expected result: The "Open bugs" card shows the same number as the Bugs page with status open

Title: Report can be downloaded as an HTML file
Steps:
1. Open Reports
2. Open the first report
3. Click "Download HTML"
Expected result: A file named test-report-<number>-....html is downloaded

Title: Lietotājs var pieteikties ar derīgu e-pastu
Steps:
1. Atver pieteikšanās lapu
2. Ievada e-pastu un paroli
3. Spiež "Ienākt"
